Geometry-derived analysis shows Ba centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Ba, 6 Mg) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Mg centers have 12 neighbors (8 Ba, 4 Mg). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that 12-vertex Ba and Mg coordination polyhedra exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
